title: Book Two · Chapter 163: The Red Border
story:
Mei stands outside the reading room with a new draft page. A red border goes around the opening times. The letters are much smaller than the border.

“Can you read this from here?” she asks Ronan.

He steps back to the next paving stone. He can see the red line clearly. He cannot read the small black words or numbers.

“I can see the page,” he says.

“Can you read it?”

“No.”

Mei looks at the border. “I spent half my break on that.”

“It is a very good line.”

“The line does not open the room.”

She sits on the step and takes a clean sheet from her folder. Ronan sits two steps below her, with his shoes on the ground.

Mei writes the times again in larger letters. This time, the red line goes only beneath the heading. She holds the paper up. Ronan moves back.

“Monday and Thursday,” he reads. “After lunch.”

“Better?”

“Much better.”

“Can you see the change for next week?”

He cannot. The small change is still at the bottom. Mei moves it beneath the main times and writes the date in larger numbers.

Jun comes out of the room and looks at both versions.

“I like the first one,” he says.

Mei points to the paving stone. “Go there.”

He goes, turns, and narrows his eyes. Then he comes back.

“I like the red border,” he says. “I cannot read the times.”

“That is Ronan's answer too.”

Jun gives Ronan a small nod. Ronan nods back. He is glad Jun agrees with him.

Miss Wu comes to the door. Mei shows her the two pages and explains the test. The teacher wants to keep the clear version. She will show it at their next room discussion.

“Yes,” Mei says. “Please put my name on the back.”

“Of course.”

Ronan feels a small pull in his stomach. He wants to make a useful page too. He also wants Miss Wu to notice it.

He looks at the red border again. Mei folds that page and puts it in her bag.

“Keeping it?” he asks.

“I may use the pattern for something else.”

“A cow?”

“Only a very important cow.”

They laugh. Jun asks Mei about their drawing work after lessons. Ronan stands up and brushes his trousers. He has his own last practice to prepare for.

Before he leaves, he walks to the paving stone once more. He reads every line on the new page from there. He can read the change for next week now. Mei turns the page over. He can read her name on the back too.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

border＝边框；draft＝草稿；version＝版本；pattern＝图案。

## 理解问题

1. Mei怎样发现并改进页面的问题？
2. Ronan看到Mei的能力被老师认可时有什么感受？

## 读句子

**She holds the paper up.**

拆开看：She / holds / the paper up.

她／举起／那张纸。
